market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. Oil above $101 and US-Iran conflict dominate. Key inflation data this week will determine Fed path. Bessent's failed buyback creates fiscal-policy uncertainty. Expect Dow to test support levels; yields likely to stay elevated. Trade war with Canada adds tail risk. Holiday-shortened week amplifies moves.
market_outlook.long_term: Energy transition and copper supercycle support industrial/metals equities. AI capex cycle intact despite data-center delays. Pharma M&A will consolidate post-trial-failure caution. Trade wars, if unresolved, create persistent headwinds for global supply chains. Social Security solvency debate may force fiscal tightening by 2028. 401(k) record savings suggest resilient household balance sheets.
